mentions.name: Nexaflow
mentions.description: A customer support AI agent platform with built-in modules so small businesses don't need to buy 4-5 separate services to run their business. Ships with CRM, ticketing, appointment/scheduler, and booking management (e.g. for small clinics). Nexaflow agents can answer and take action on customer queries coming from WhatsApp, email, web widget, and more.
mentions.problem: Small businesses typically need to buy 4-5 separate services to run their business.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building https://nexaflow.com - a customer support AI agent with built-in modules so small businesses need not buy 4-5 services to run a business. We ship with CRM, Ticketing, Appointment/Scheduler, Booking management system (for Small clinics, etc). Nexaflow agents can answer (and take action on) customer queries coming from Whatsapp, Email, Web (widget) and more.
mentions.author: murukesh_s
